question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

JJ_K_LM_N_ _ O _ _ Q _ R _
solution:
**Given series:** JJ_K_LM_N_ _ O _ _ Q _ R _

Option 1) KLMNOPPQR → JJ __**K**__K __**L**__L M__**M **__N__**N**__ __**O**__O __**P**____**P**__ Q__**Q**__ R__**R**__ →** (It follows the pattern of: JJ - KK - LL - MM - NN - OO - PP - QQ - RR)**

Option 2) IJKLMNOPQ → JJ **__I__**K __J__LM__K__N**__L__ __M__** O __N__ __O__ Q __P__ R __Q__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) KLNOPPQRS → JJ__K__K__L__LM__N__N__O__ __P__ O __P__ __Q__ Q __R__ R __S__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) JKNNOOPRR → JJ__J__K__K__LM__N__N__N__ __O__ O __O__ __P__ Q __R__ R __R__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
